extracted.intended_audience: stand-up comedians and comedy writers studying Hannibal Buress's storytelling-witness style
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for writing and performing stand-up in the Hannibal Buress storytelling-witness vein: laid-back delivery, mundane-specific observations, narrative framing, and ironic wisecracks that dismiss opposition. Focuses on crafting material and performance choices that produce surprise via mismatch and emotional investment via story.

rubrics_metrics.name: Understated delivery relative to the content
rubrics_metrics.description: Is the delivery understated relative to the content? (Laid-back, almost sleepy delivery disguising sharp material.)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Perform with a low-energy/laid-back cadence so that the material's sharpness contrasts with delivery; this mismatch creates surprise. Avoid overly animated or emphatic delivery that removes the contrast. Example phrasing from the page: 'Laid-back, almost sleepy delivery disguising sharp material.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Observation about the unremarkable / mundane specificity
rubrics_metrics.description: Is the observation about the unremarkable? (Finds comedy in everyday, seemingly unimportant things.)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Focus on specific, mundane targets (apple juice, dentists, escalators) and make the observation precise enough that audiences wonder how they missed it. Specificity is key: concrete, odd small details make the premise feel fresh.

rubrics_metrics.name: Primarily storytelling (narrative) structure
rubrics_metrics.description: Does the joke primarily take the form of a story/narrative rather than a one-liner or pure observational bit?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use narrative arcs to create investment and allow the punchline to land against an established scenario. The page emphasizes 'primarily storytelling jokes (narrative)' and that 'story format creates investment.' Avoid purely abstract or disconnected jokes if aiming for this style.

rubrics_metrics.name: Storytelling-witness stance (more witness than critic)
rubrics_metrics.description: Does the material adopt a 'witness' stance—fixating on how the world intersects the performer's life—rather than broad critique of society?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Keep the POV personal and observational about intersections with the performer's life. The page notes 'More of a witness than a critic' and that the act 'doesn't depict a larger social world directly.' Avoid turning the bit into a general polemic or lecture.

rubrics_metrics.name: Establishes a sympathetic point of view
rubrics_metrics.description: Does the narrative establish a sympathetic POV for the performer/character in the story?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Make the narrator relatable so audiences are invested in the story's stakes; sympathetic POV helps the later wisecrack land as a surprise rather than alienation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Punchline punches harder than the delivery suggests
rubrics_metrics.description: Does the punchline punch harder than the delivery suggests? (Punchline should 'punch above' a sleepy delivery.)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Craft a punchline with sharper content than the understated setup implies. Timing and restraint in delivery increase the perceived force of the punch. The rubric explicitly asks: 'Does the punchline punch harder than the delivery suggests?'

rubrics_metrics.name: Dismisses counterarguments economically
rubrics_metrics.description: Are counterarguments dismissed economically and efficiently within the bit?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Anticipate and briefly neutralize obvious rebuttals with short ironic lines or wisecracks rather than extended rebuttal. The essay notes 'Dismisses counterarguments preemptively' and asks 'Are counterarguments dismissed economically?'

rubrics_metrics.name: Identifies incongruences across ordinary domains
rubrics_metrics.description: Does the material identify incongruences in daily life, American society, pop culture, or invented hypothetical scenarios?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Look for and exploit small mismatches or contradictions in mundane contexts or cultural conventions; the page lists these target domains explicitly as sources of material. Use hypothetical scenarios of the performer's own design as fertile ground.

rubrics_metrics.name: Establishes moralistic high ground in narrative
rubrics_metrics.description: Does the story establish a moralistic high ground that the narrator can occupy, implicitly or explicitly?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Position the narrator in a way that justifies ironic observations or wisecracks; this helps make dismissals of opposition feel earned. The page states: 'Establishes moralistic high ground in narrative.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Dismantles potential opposition through ironic wisecracks
rubrics_metrics.description: Does the bit dismantle potential opposition using ironic wisecracks rather than direct confrontation?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use wit and irony to deflate counterarguments or objections; the style favors short, ironic wisecracks that undercut opponents. The page says: 'Dismantles potential opposition through ironic wisecracks.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Sleepy delivery + sharp content = surprise via mismatch
rubrics_metrics.description: Does the routine leverage the mismatch between sleepy delivery and sharp content to create surprise?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Make the emotional/energetic tone of delivery noticeably lower than the intellectual or moral sharpness of the material so the contrast itself becomes comedic. The page summarizes this as a core mechanism: 'Sleepy delivery + sharp content = surprise via mismatch.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Wisecrack at the end that overperforms delivery
rubrics_metrics.description: Is there a final wisecrack or tag that 'punches above' the established delivery and serves as the payoff?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: End the story with a concise, elevated wisecrack that exceeds the energy of the preceding delivery; this late uplift is a recurring structural move in the described style ('Wisecrack at the end punches above its delivery').
